sources.fact: LBBD Regulation 19 Cabinet HTML lists S_YG - Garages at Kier Hardy Way as a site-allocation attachment.
Cabinet approved publication of the Regulation 19 submission Local Plan; this is plan-making provenance, not a planning permission.
LBBD states the Local Plan 2037 was adopted on 18 September 2024.
The Local Plan is the starting point for decision-making but does not itself grant YG permission.
The adopted Local Plan forms part of the Development Plan used when assessing applications.
LBBD/Be First provides the current statutory planning application service.
Planning applications and policy are separate services from land-charge searches.
LBBD states Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; site allocation is not consent.
Land-charge searches require an accurate site location plan and do not substitute for exact title geometry.
CIL rules concern development granted or deemed permission and do not prove YG has permission.
Building-control processes are kept distinct from planning permission and allocation status.
No exact current YG residential application/decision was verified from accessible official HTML this wave.

examples.result: YG allocation identity is revalidated from Cabinet HTML.
